item.title: Pebble Index routing and decision models
item.description:
I’ve been using a Pebble Index for the last couple of months and while I dislike the fact it’s a consumable, it’s been a very handy little piece of technology. Short notes and thoughts easily drafted down is something I really do like. The app isn’t really my jam however, but they do offer an option to call a webhook!

So, my first thing I wanted it better routing for my notes. Here are a couple of example I’ve been using it for:
